statement: For the actual five-adic quartic CM lattices V, Vchi2, V(1), V(1)chi2 and U_CM, all finite H2 over G_Q,{2,5} vanish, finite H1 is cyclic of order5^n, and integral H1 is Z5. Twelve fully certified degree8 character fields, actual torsion-point field inclusions, and explicit ideal extension/norm inverses prove vanishing of both degree32 division fields' five-primary class groups. The actual decomposition groups kill the finite Brauer-coefficient invariants. Unrestricted H1 of each twisted Tate module is Z5; H1(U_CM) is Z5 plus the restricted Z5 coefficient module over primes3 mod4, with exact tame-inertia projections and cocycle sections. Every nonempty central quartic fibre at5 has evaluated module Z5^66 plus six all-prime, three split-prime and three inert-prime restricted modules, with all original coefficient maps retained.
